item.title: Best Household Budgeting Apps for Families That Actually Share Money
item.description: Managing one person's money is a budgeting problem. Managing a household's money is a sharing problem: two or more people spend from the same pot, and the tool has to keep everyone seeing the same numbers without handing everyone the same password. Spreadsheets blur who spent what; single-user apps force one person to be the family bookkeeper. This guide compares 12 household budgeting apps on the thing that actually decides
